# Module notes

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `1a80fc8`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


One sentence on what each busy folder, and each file to be careful with, is for. Written from names only (paths, function and class names), not from reading the code.

## Folders

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/app`: Manages documents, sessions, and context for the CAD viewer app.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor`: Handles command operations and iterators for the CAD editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/command`: Manages command execution and aliasing in the CAD editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/global`: Controls UI theme, layout, and messaging for the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/input/ui`: Manages touch input, floating inputs, and interaction strategies.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/view`: Handles entity visibility, selection, and view modes in the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/i18n`: Manages internationalization and localization messages.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/service`: Handles layer and entity services and selections.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui`: Manages dialogs, notifications, and UI panels.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/util`: Provides utilities for color, measurement, and database edits.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view`: Manages layout and entity display for the viewer.
- `packages/vite-config`: Contains Rollup output plugin configurations for Vite.

## Files to be careful with

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui/AcUiFullscreenPanel.ts`: Manages fullscreen UI panel behavior and history.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/command/draw/AcApSplineCmd.ts`: Executes spline commands and builds spline entities.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view/AcTrLayout.ts`: Manages layout entities and layer operations.
- `packages/cad-svg-plugin/src/AcSvgEntity.ts`: Handles SVG entity rendering and transformations.
- `packages/pdf-renderer/src/renderer/AcPdfEntity.ts`: Manages PDF entity operations and transformations.
